table: Census Business Dynamics Statistics 2023 release, establishment job creation and destruction rates (percent of average employment) by establishment employment size, nation and state. Each rate is the mean of the yearly rates over the window, with the lowest and highest year as the spread. Job creation is split into opening establishments (births) and expanding ones (continuers); destruction into closing (deaths) and contracting ones (continuers). Continuer rates are the continuer counts over the table's denominator.
window: 2010-2019 and 2022-2023 (pandemic years 2020-2021 left out), as data/research/business/bds-2023.json
estimatedFrom: Yearly BDS establishment rates by size class averaged over the window; the nation and each state are separate rows (states with fewer than 6 yearly values for a size class are left out).
